purpose: Teach: 長田/井口/小西/宮澤/田辺/塩川/児玉/本間

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、長田氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were young, you built that joint venture with Nagata, didn't you.
lines.style: Gentle, unhurried. Slight lift on the recall—not a question, a quiet acknowledgment. Patient warmth. The voice of someone settling into memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは井口先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: I did. Father learned so much from Inoue's mentorship back then.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. A quiet bow in the voice. Steady gaze into the past. Speaking with the care of someone honoring what was given to him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、小西氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: And when you were younger still, you planned that overseas expansion with Konishi.
lines.style: Softer now. A thread of wistfulness pulling through. Slow, deliberate pacing. The voice of someone turning old pages.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは宮澤氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. Father had Miyazawa as the backbone of our communications then.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. A slight pause before the name—placing it carefully in time. Steady voice, anchored. The weight of years in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、田辺氏と経理体制を整えられた
lines.en: In those early days, you and Tanabe restructured the accounting function.
lines.style: The same unhurried rhythm. A faint smile beneath the surface—pride without boasting. Reaching back into capable hands. Voice trailing gently at the period.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは塩川氏を主任として育てられた
lines.en: We did. Father raised Shiokawa up as a department head during that time.
lines.style: Steady and certain. Pride in the development of people, not in the accomplishment alone. Warm but composed. The voice of someone who still sees the result of what was built.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、児玉氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: And you founded the overseas subsidiary with Kodama when you were still quite young.
lines.style: The softest line yet. A long, patient exhale underneath. Slow. The voice settling into the deepest part of memory. Slight trailing-off, as if the past is still unfolding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは本間氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: That's right. Father gave Honma the entire legal operation to manage from the start.
lines.style: This is the closing reflection. Calm, complete. The faintest note of closure—not sadness, but the peace of having entrusted well. Voice steady and clear. The final thread tied.
